title: Roasted carrot and chickpea wraps
blurb: Soft tortillas filled with roasted vegetables, chickpeas and a garlic tahini sauce
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C. Cut the carrots into thin batons and the peppers into strips, then toss them with half the olive oil and the cumin on a baking tray.
Roast the vegetables for 20 minutes until softened and lightly charred at the edges.
Meanwhile, crush the garlic and mix it with the tahini, lemon juice and yoghurt in a small bowl, adding a tablespoon of water to loosen if needed.
Drain the chickpeas and toss them with the remaining olive oil.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for a few seconds on each side.
Spread the tahini sauce down the centre of each tortilla, then add the roasted vegetables and chickpeas.
Roll up the tortillas, folding in the ends as you go, then cut each one in half to serve.
